# Icons8 "Liquid Glass" icons

Item icons of Achmage Workbench (projects, folders, conversations, web pages and document kinds).
Artwork by Icons8. Source: https://icons8.com/icons/set/file-type--style-liquid-glass
(https://icons8.com/icons/liquid-glass). Licence: https://icons8.com/license — free use requires
attribution; the app shows "아이콘: Icons8" with a link to https://icons8.com in 설정 › 정보.
The app shows each icon tinted with one colour per kind (the PNG's own shape as a mask).

Files (100 × 100 PNG) and where they came from:

From Atlas File Manager's copy (https://github.com/neondeex/atlas-filemanager,
crates/atlas-ui/assets/icons/filetypes/liquid-glass/, downloaded there from Icons8 with the same licence):
- document.png, file.png, folder.png, image.png, pdf.png, presentation.png

From Icons8 directly (2026-11-15):
- create-new.png    https://img.icons8.com/liquid-glass/100/create-new.png      (프로젝트: a note with a pen)
- chat.png          https://img.icons8.com/liquid-glass/100/chat.png            (대화)
- ms-word.png       https://img.icons8.com/liquid-glass/100/ms-word.png         (Word)
- ms-excel.png      https://img.icons8.com/liquid-glass/100/ms-excel.png        (Excel)
- globe.png         https://img.icons8.com/liquid-glass/100/globe.png           (웹 페이지)
- paint-palette.png https://img.icons8.com/liquid-glass/100/paint-palette.png   (디자인)

한글(HWP/HWPX) and Markdown have no icon of their own in the set: both use document.png, in two colours.
